page.overview:
Who is Drayton?

is a character appearing in . He is one of the members of the Blueberry Academy BB League's Elite Four, specializing in types.

Drayton is a young man with short spiky hair, with a long single hair tuft with a purple streak, as well as a pair of yellow eyes. He wears a white t-shirt that is covered by a black/gold tracksuit, which has the design of a gold Maschiff on the back and sleeves. He also wears a purple cape tied down around his waist.

Drayton is very laid back and relaxed, often living a "lazy" lifestyle; Carmine states that he had been repeating classes for three years. Despite his seemingly lazy exterior, he does care about his friends and is a proficient trainer; his fellow member Lacey, who has an advantage over him with -types, has not beaten him once.

Whenever something disappoints or embarrasses him, his long hair tuft and the smaller tufts droop down.
